operation_id.where: receipts sidecar: seq 0..2, each with memory_id and a hash chained to prev

timestamp_ms.where: receipts sidecar ts (float seconds, sub-millisecond); history valid_from and invalidated_at

operation_type.where: history policy labels the retirement (keyed_lww, keyed_reaffirm); the revert record carries meta.revert_of and meta.reverted_from; there is no single enum field named type

motive.where: no human-readable reason is stored with a correction or a revert; the policy label says WHAT rule retired a value, not WHY the caller wrote it

content_snapshot.where: every version keeps its full text; history returns all three versions verbatim, superseded ones included

alternatives.where: no record of what the store could have done and did not (for example: refused, queued for review, kept both)

rollback_path.where: revert(key) restores the prior value as a new record and retires the current one; both stay in history, so the rollback is itself auditable and reversible

operator_identity.where: remember() records agent_id per version (history shows ops-bot then rasto) and source binds an origin document; the record a revert creates carries no agent_id

lifecycle.detect_only: observe() counts contradicting observations with distinct support; one is pending (need 2), the second reopens the settled record into a review queue
lifecycle.human_step: resolve_reopened(id, 'keep_current' | 'reaffirm_prior') is the only exit; the store never marks a reopened record resolved on its own
lifecycle.no_prescription: contradictions() and check_conflict() return pairs and similarity; neither returns a recommendation
